create_harmony_parser: create a Harmony parser instance that switches between canonical and text-based strategies for parsing streaming text
parse_harmony_chunk: parse a Harmony format text chunk and return a list of events with type, content, and raw text
parse_canonical_channel_block: parse a canonical Harmony channel block with START, CHANNEL, MESSAGE, and RETURN markers into structured events
parse_text_fallback_format: parse a text-based Harmony fallback format using regex patterns for analysis, commentary, and final sections
tokenize_harmony_stream: iterate over structural tokens like START, CHANNEL, MESSAGE, CALL, RETURN in a Harmony text stream
